generalModule.title: Product general
generalModule.description: Stable product profile questions that should be captured before utility-specific scoring begins.

questions.prompt: What is the product name?
Describe the product in one grounded operating paragraph: what it helps a team do, in what workflow, and with what practical boundary.
What logo URL or placeholder asset reference should PAT use for this product?
When a buyer asks what this product actually helps them improve, how should PAT position it in plain operating terms?
Who is the primary target customer, buyer, or operator for this product today?
What real use context, workflow pressure, or operating situation is this product meant to handle?
How is this product typically implemented, configured, or rolled out in practice?
What kind of operating model, team maturity, or process discipline does this product fit best right now?
Who usually owns the buying, approval, or rollout decision for this product?
How should PAT describe this product's integration posture: native system depth, connector dependence, data handoff burden, or interoperability limits?

openEndedModule.title: Product open-ended
openEndedModule.description: Final text questions for nuance, risk, and context that should not be collapsed into a score.

questions.prompt: In which workflow or operating situation does this product currently look strongest, and what evidence supports that read?
In which workflow or operating situation does this product currently look weakest, and what evidence gap or operating limit drives that read?
What is the most material implementation or rollout risk for this product right now?
What user, operator, or buyer-side change-management risk is most likely to slow adoption?
What integration, data, or interoperability gap matters most before PAT should treat this product as stronger than directional?
What control, approval, auditability, or governance concern deserves explicit follow-up?
Based on current evidence, what firm size (FTEs) and firm type appear to be the best-fit customer or operator for this product today?
Based on current evidence, what firm size (FTEs) and firm type appear to be the worst-fit customer or operator for this product today, and why?
What additional evidence would most improve confidence, calibration, or operator usefulness in this product next?
What is the single most sensible next action after this review: gather evidence, narrow scope, reposition, or continue?
